annotations.title: Get API X402 programacao by slug by dia

description:
Seven days of the channel's schedule that end on the requested day, for an agent, paid per call, with no account.
Up to seven collected days of the channel in one response, without an account or pass. The programa parameter selects by title or category and ignores case and accents. agenda=1 adds agenda_ics, ready to import, with UTC times and unique events. The resumo field gives the days consulted and the showings. The agenda is a file, not a subscription to updates. The free daily reading keeps the same data. A missing channel, day or program, and unavailable history, are not charged. When delivery is available, an unpaid request receives 402, and a paid request receives the result and cobranca.

agenda.description: Include agenda_ics with the selected calendar events.

dia.description: Last day of the requested week, YYYY-MM-DD.

programa.description: Title or category substring. Input and matches are not truncated.

slug.description: Stored slug of the channel, from the collection.
